source:
@@U00250@@
you proved yourself the people's friend.
Many a man among us has your father
to thank for his life.
When burning fever raged, your father
snatched many of us from the grip of death
when he put an end to the pestilence.
Young as you were,
you entered each house,
no matter the danger;
and though many a corpse left feet first,
you always emerged from every dwelling,
safe and sound,
and shouldered many bitter trials,
the helper helped by the Helper on high.

@@U00252@@
Let’s drink health to this trusty man!
Long may he live to help in our need!

@@U00254@@
Bow your heads to Him
Who teaches us to help the helpless!

@@U00255@@
(浮士德 and 瓦格纳 go on.)

@@U00257@@
Great man, what a joy you must feel
to have such reverence from the masses!
Happy the man who from his talents
can reap so grand a reward!
Fathers point you out to their sons,
all ask questions,
crowd around you,
jostle for room,
the fiddles stop,
the dancers pause,
and as you pass on by
they stand in rows and caps go flying.
It wouldn’t take much to make them kneel
as if the Host were seen approaching.
translation:
@@U00250@@
你证明了自己是人民的朋友。
我们当中很多人都有你的父亲
感谢他的一生。
当高烧肆虐时，你的父亲
将我们许多人从死亡的魔掌中救了出来
当他结束瘟疫时。
年轻时的你，
你走进每一栋房子，
无论危险如何；
尽管许多尸体先离开了脚，
你总是从每个住处出现，
安全无恙，
并承受了许多痛苦的考验，
被高处的帮助者所帮助的帮助者。

@@U00252@@
让我们为这个值得信赖的人干杯健康吧！
愿他长寿，为我们的需要提供帮助！

@@U00254@@
向他低下头
谁教我们去帮助无助的人！

@@U00255@@
（浮士德和瓦格纳继续。）

@@U00257@@
伟大的男人，你一定感到多么高兴
能够受到群众的如此崇敬！
幸福的人源于他的才华
能收获如此丰厚的回报！
父亲们向他们的儿子们指出你，
都提出问题，
你周围的人群，
争抢房间，
小提琴停止了，
舞者们停下来，
当你经过时
他们站成一排，帽子飞扬。
不需要太多就能让他们跪下
就好像看到宿主正在接近一样。
